Why MyCityLofts

What buyers gain with us

Buying abroad is a matter of trust. We guide you from the first search to the keys, and beyond.

I

First access

Off-market homes are presented to our buyers before they ever reach a public listing.

II

Six languages, one advisor

French, English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Russian: one person follows your project from start to finish.

III

A trusted circle

Notaries, bankers, lawyers and architects who secure financing, due diligence and structuring.

IV

From search to keys

Visits, negotiation, signature, then interior design if you wish, so your new home is ready to live in.

Services

Four disciplines, one point of contact

We work with bankers, notaries, architects and licensed estate agents so that every recommendation rests on verified expertise.

i.

International buyer introductions

Your property presented to our file of foreign buyers, with the sale itself carried out by a licensed partner agent in the country concerned.

ii.

Confidential valuation

Market analysis and an opinion of value for your property, at your home or remotely, with no obligation to sell.

iii.

Interior design

A dedicated department that brings out a property's potential before it goes on the market, or designs it for those moving in.

iv.

Strategic and wealth advisory

Support for companies and private clients in their investments and wealth management, worldwide.

Interior design

Interiors with a soul

Our Villa Saïd project in Paris's 16th arrondissement shows our approach: open volumes, noble materials, contemporary art and controlled light. Well-staged homes sell faster and hold their price.

About

A property is not only for those who walk past it. MyCityLofts was created to show it to the people looking for it from London, Miami or Dubai.

Among the fastest-growing companies in Belgium, Trends Gazelles 2016.

Founded in Brussels in September 2012 by Aurélie Dupassieux, MyCityLofts gives owners access to a network of foreign buyers alongside local clients. The brand, registered with INPI since 2014, is present in France, Belgium, the United Kingdom and Spain.

MyCityLofts combines advisory, valuation, interior design and international buyer introductions. Sales are carried out with licensed partner agents in each country, and we meet you wherever suits you, in strict confidence.

  1. 2012MyCityLofts founded in Brussels
  2. 2014Brand registered with INPI · real-estate licence obtained in Paris
  3. 2015Licensed estate agent with the IPI, Brussels
  4. 2016Trends Gazelles award · two agencies opened in Málaga, new offices in Brussels and London
